text: After a crash on Highway 69, the salesman Eun-soo wakes in a dark forest, and a little girl leads him to the House of Happy Children, where [three smiling children watch his every move|rules|trapped with no way out]. The meat at dinner is [the flesh of a missing father|images|food, drink and drugs], and a woman has become a china doll. In the siblings' notebook Eun-soo finds his own picture and learns that [the eldest boy can reshape people by imagining it|threat|powers of the mind], and that the children [only want parents who will stay|wants|to be loved and belong].
